source_note: Per-cell dispositions for the three source sheets Packet 71 delivered. Cells were separated by npm run chop:source-sheet, which projects each sheet's own alpha onto both axes after clearing background haze at alpha<=8; body rig rows come from measureBodyRig in scripts/art-asset-factory/pg-modular-intake.ts and are a pure function of the raster. Regenerate the chops with the commands in art/qa/p71/*_chop.json.

cells.poseDescription: Arms relaxed at the sides, square to camera, feet together.
cells.reason: Chopped cleanly and geometrically sound, but the silhouette carries a green contour on 68.9% of its soft-edge pixels. The approved character style authority PG_STYLE_REFERENCE_CHARACTER_P005_APPROVED.png has no silhouette stroke at all, and at this body's runtime width of roughly 250 plate pixels the contour is plainly visible as a green rim. Not a quality judgement on the figure, which is good: an edge treatment to re-export.
cells.attachmentAnchorNote: No attachment anchors are authored. D-068 requires a production body's six semantic anchors to be measured from the raster that actually ships; this raster is going to be re-exported, so anchors measured now would be thrown away, and authoring them to look complete is the exact failure D-068 records.

Chopped cleanly, true alpha, no fringe, and drawn well. Not composable as delivered: the pair is bonded into one three-quarter product view with the two shoes overlapping, and the body family stands front-on with the feet separated and the toes toward the camera. The existing footwear contract attaches one raster to a single 'feet' anchor and the released fixture for it is a flat front-on strip. An orientation re-render, not a redesign.

poseFamilyCoverage.standing-neutral: SATISFIED — two variants, cells R1C1 and R1C3.
poseFamilyCoverage.standing-conversational: SATISFIED — two variants, cells R1C2 and R2C1.
poseFamilyCoverage.standing-listening: PARTIAL — no cell depicts an attentive listening posture distinct from standing-neutral. Either of the two neutral cells could be authored as listening, but neither shows the settled weight and stilled hands the family means.
poseFamilyCoverage.seated-guest-neutral: SATISFIED — four seated cells, R1C4, R2C2, R2C3 and R2C4.
poseFamilyCoverage.seated-at-desk: PARTIAL — the seated cells rest their hands on lap, knees or forward in a gesture. None places the forearms at a work surface, so a desk pose would be a reinterpretation rather than a match.
poseFamilyCoverage.standing-podium-or-lectern: MISSING — no cell stands at a lectern or rests hands on a raised surface. This is the one adult pose the sheet does not provide, and it is still needed.
